meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: Claude 会获得一组 lsp 工具:查看语言服务器状态、对文件或目录跑诊断、跳转到定义、查找引用、列出符号,以及在重命名前校验并执行重命名。这些是工具调用,不是 shell 命令。
howto.when: 当你需要当前工作区的语言服务器诊断、定义跳转、引用查找等能力时触发。诊断提示缺少语言服务器时,先看 lsp.status。

say.text: 用 lsp.status 看一下当前配置了哪些语言服务器
say.note: 列出已配置、已安装、缺失或被禁用的服务器

say.text: 检查一下 src/index.ts 的诊断错误
say.note: 对该文件跑 LSP 诊断,可只筛 error

say.text: 查找 handleClick 在整个项目里的引用位置
say.note: 跨工作区找出该符号的所有使用处

howto.what_en: Claude gains lsp tools: check language-server status, run diagnostics on a file or directory, jump to definitions, find references, list symbols, and check or apply renames. These are tool calls, not shell commands.
howto.when_en: Use when you need language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace. If a server is missing, check lsp.status first.

say_en.text: Check which language servers are configured with lsp.status
say_en.note: Lists configured, installed, missing, or disabled servers
Checks that file for LSP diagnostics, e.g. errors only

say_en.text: Find where handleClick is referenced across the workspace
say_en.note: Returns all usages of that symbol in the workspace
